description: Correctness definitions for the external training comparison. A baseline passes correctness only if its final training state matches the frozen C0 dense reference (A_s, foreach=False) under the canonical hashing below. Hashes are order-sensitive, little-endian float32, SHA256. NO tolerance: a baseline either hash-matches or it is EXACTNESS_FAIL.

reference.state: theta (xyz,shs,opacity,scaling,rotation) + exp_avg (m) + exp_avg_sq (v) + global step + alive mask

state_hash.definition: SHA256 over the concatenation, in fixed order, of the little-endian float32 bytes of: alive theta_xyz, theta_shs, theta_opacity, theta_scaling, theta_rotation, m_xyz, m_shs, m_opacity, m_scaling, m_rotation; followed by int64 global step and int64 alive count.
state_hash.scope: ALIVE rows only, in alive-index order (stable row ordering after compaction).

topology_hash.definition: SHA256 over the ordered log of every densification event (iteration, event_type in {clone,split,prune}, parent_ids, child_ids, n_rows_before, n_rows_after) plus the final alive-row id sequence.

lineage_consistency.definition: Every clone/split child's (theta, m, v) at birth equals the canonical function of its parent(s): clone = exact copy; split = N=2 children with scale s/(0.8*N), position rotation@normal(0,scale)+parent_xyz, rotation/SH/opacity inherited. Verified by re-deriving each child from its logged parent state and hashing.
lineage_consistency.pass_condition: all children re-derive bit-exactly (zero mismatches across the run)

gates.exactness_verdict: PASS iff C1 and C2 and C3; else EXACTNESS_FAIL (no tolerance rescue)

notes: These definitions reuse the canonical serialisation in lavos0_headroom/lavos0/hashing.py (hash_tensor_list, hash_int) and the ReproTopo determinism harness.

External baselines (FastGS, Sparse Adam, gsplat) are expected to FAIL C1/C2/C3 because they alter the optimizer math or densification; they are still measured for efficiency/quality, but marked EXACTNESS_FAIL and not ranked against exact methods on speed.
The frozen C0 reference itself is the dense trajectory; VOS/ReproTopo/LAVOS must hash-match it at iteration 30000.
